name: nanum_pen_script
description: The Nanum fonts (Korean : 나눔글꼴) are unicode fonts designed especially for the Korean-language script, designed by Sandoll Communications (Korean : 산돌 커뮤니케이션) and Fontrix (Korean : 폰트릭스). The publisher is Naver. Nanum Pen Script is a contemporary pen script with a warm touch and is expertly hinted for screen use.
